01-jetblue-a320.parties: Airbus S.A.S. (seller) and JetBlue Airways Corporation (buyer)
01-jetblue-a320.size: §0.1 identifies 22 A320 backlog aircraft, 30 A321 backlog aircraft and 40 firm A320 NEO aircraft. §3 base price components are redacted.
01-jetblue-a320.scope: New-build A320 family purchase with configuration, price revision, delay, acceptance, warranty and support.

02-united-boeing.parties: The Boeing Company (seller) and United Air Lines, Inc. (customer)
02-united-boeing.governingLaw: No standalone choice located in PA 3427. The preamble incorporates and amends AGTA-UAL.
02-united-boeing.size: 787-8 order. Articles 1 and 3.1 refer quantity and basic price to Table 1, with economic data withheld.
02-united-boeing.scope: OEM purchase with advance payments, escalation exhibits and support obligations.

03-lan-boeing.parties: The Boeing Company (seller) and LAN Airlines S.A. (customer)
03-lan-boeing.agreementDate: July 2007 (signature page leaves the day blank)
03-lan-boeing.governingLaw: No standalone choice located in PA 3194. The preamble incorporates AGTA-LAN.
03-lan-boeing.size: 777 freighter order. Table 1 withholds aircraft basic price and shows a $230,000 proposal-acceptance deposit per aircraft.
03-lan-boeing.scope: OEM freighter purchase with advance-payment catch-up, configuration and spares support.

04-airtran-boeing.parties: The Boeing Company (seller) and AirTran Airways, Inc. (customer)
04-airtran-boeing.governingLaw: No standalone choice located in PA 2444. The preamble incorporates AGTA-CQT.
04-airtran-boeing.size: 737-7BD order. Articles 1 and 3.1 refer to Table 1, which is redacted. §3.3 treats prices for later deliveries separately.
04-airtran-boeing.scope: OEM purchase with model substitution and option agreements.

05-baltia-kalitta.parties: Kalitta Air, L.L.C. (seller) and Baltia Air Lines, Inc. (buyer)
05-baltia-kalitta.size: One used 747-251B airframe without engines (recitals). Purchase price $1,100,000 (§2).
05-baltia-kalitta.scope: As-is airframe sale with a landing-gear condition, inspection acceptance and a warranty bill of sale.

06-coachmen.parties: Coachmen Industries, Inc. (seller) and Hudson Company of Tennessee (purchaser)
06-coachmen.governingLaw: No express governing-law choice located in the filed agreement.
06-coachmen.scope: Used aircraft sale with inspection, corrective work, an escrowed deposit and written delivery acceptance.

07-microstrategy.size: One new Global Express XRS for $46,025,685 (Articles 1 and 2.1).
07-microstrategy.scope: Business-jet OEM purchase covering completion, staged payments, delay and a move-up option.

08-tempus.parties: ME Aviation Services, LLC (seller) and Tempus Applied Solutions Holdings, Inc. (purchaser)
08-tempus.size: Six L-1011 aircraft (cover). Defined purchase price $3,500,000, represented by shares (§1.1).
08-tempus.scope: Portfolio sale with a package-wide inspection election and pre-closing conditions.

09-wwe.parties: Bombardier Aerospace Corporation (seller) and World Wrestling Entertainment, Inc. (purchaser)
09-wwe.scope: Sale of an existing business jet with inspection, deemed rejection and risk-of-loss provisions.

10-spirit-sale.parties: Spirit Airlines, Inc. (seller) and GA Telesis, LLC (buyer)
10-spirit-sale.size: 23 used A320 and A321 aircraft. Exhibit A's base purchase prices total $518,896,500 before §3.2 delivery adjustments.
10-spirit-sale.scope: Fleet sale with separate deliveries, technical acceptance, milestones and owner-trustee designation.

11-aircastle-shared-terms.parties: LATAM Airlines Group S.A. (lessee). The relevant aircraft lease identifies its lessor.
11-aircastle-shared-terms.size: Shared terms for individual leases. Schedule 1 refers the periodic rent amount to §1.1 of the relevant aircraft lease agreement.
11-aircastle-shared-terms.scope: Terms incorporated into aircraft leases covering payment, loss, default, remedies and redelivery.

12-midway-lease.parties: Aviation Financial Services Inc. (lessor) and Midway Airlines Corporation (lessee)
12-midway-lease.governingLaw: New York, expressly confirmed on incorporation of common terms (§7).
12-midway-lease.size: One 737-700, serial 32582 (cover). Schedule B, Part III withholds monthly rent.
12-midway-lease.scope: Aircraft-specific lease incorporating common terms, with deposit, rent and return schedules.

13-airtran-common-terms.parties: Aviation Financial Services Inc. and AirTran Airways, Inc.
13-airtran-common-terms.governingLaw: New York (§15.8 and Schedule 1, Governing Law).
13-airtran-common-terms.size: Common terms. §5.3(b) refers to Schedule B of each aircraft lease for rent.
13-airtran-common-terms.scope: Shared drafting for aircraft leases covering information covenants, insurance, maintenance and default.

14-kitty-hawk-terms.parties: Aviation Financial Services Inc. and Kitty Hawk Aircargo, Inc.
14-kitty-hawk-terms.governingLaw: New York (§15.8 and Schedule 1, Governing Law).
14-kitty-hawk-terms.size: Common terms. §5.3(b) refers the rent calculation to the aircraft lease.
14-kitty-hawk-terms.scope: Common lease terms with separate default clocks for rent, supplemental rent and other amounts.

15-frontier-lease.parties: AFS Investments XVI LLC (lessor) and Frontier Airlines, Inc. (lessee)
15-frontier-lease.governingLaw: The recitals incorporate separate common terms. No standalone general choice located in this aircraft lease.
15-frontier-lease.size: One A319. Schedule B, Part III sets assumed rents of $205,900, $215,900 and $225,900 for periods 1–12, 13–24 and later periods, subject to adjustments.
15-frontier-lease.scope: Aircraft-specific lease with rent schedules, security and maintenance payments.

16-aircastle-lease.parties: Maersk Aircraft A/S (lessor) and Sterling Airlines A/S (lessee)
16-aircastle-lease.size: One 737-700, serial 28010 (cover). §5.1.1 requires monthly rent. The Annex K calculation is redacted.
16-aircastle-lease.scope: Lease with deposit rights across defined leases, reserve adjustments and insurance-proceeds allocation.

17-airlease.parties: First Union National Bank (solely as trustee lessor), CSI Aviation Services, Inc. (lessee) and Airlease Ltd. (owner participant)
17-airlease.size: One DC-9 Series 82 (cover). Schedule 2 specifies $125,000 monthly basic rent for the first year and $120,000 monthly if extended beyond 30 September 2002.
17-airlease.scope: Owner-trust lease with separate basic rent, component payments, insurance and filing covenants.

18-ubiquiti-lease.parties: RJP Manageco, LLC (lessor) and Ubiquiti Networks, Inc. (lessee)
18-ubiquiti-lease.size: One CL600-2B16 at $5,000 per flight hour (§3.3 and Exhibits A–B).
18-ubiquiti-lease.scope: Non-exclusive dry lease with scheduling, insurer roles and termination on written notice.

19-williams-sonoma.parties: WHL Management LLC (lessor) and Williams-Sonoma, Inc. (lessee)
19-williams-sonoma.size: One Global 5000 (recitals). Stated term 36 months subject to early termination. Basic rent $375,000 per calendar month with partial-month proration (§§2–3(b)).
19-williams-sonoma.scope: Corporate aircraft lease with operating costs, insurance, defaults and a mortgage assignment provision.

20-lan-common-terms.parties: GE Commercial Aviation Services Limited and LAN Cargo S.A.
20-lan-common-terms.governingLaw: New York (§15.8 and Schedule 1, Governing Law).
20-lan-common-terms.size: Common terms. §5.3(b) refers to the applicable aircraft lease for the rent calculation.
20-lan-common-terms.scope: Cargo-airline lease framework covering delivery, rent, reports, event of loss and default.

21-global-crossing-finance.parties: Bank of Utah (solely as owner trustee lessor) and Global Crossing Airlines, Inc. (lessee)
21-global-crossing-finance.size: One used A320-232, serial 5999. Schedule 9 provides the airframe financing schedule and $50,000 periodic rent per engine, prorated for partial months.
21-global-crossing-finance.scope: Airframe financing alongside engine rental, with a purchase option and a residual payment on non-exercise.
